purpose: Compress the completed chronological review of all 6,115 pre-2020 mother-event charts into one causal lifecycle, freeze it before annual aggregation, and run it once on consumed development history.
disclosure: The direction and lifecycle were generated by reviewing outcome-labeled 2015-2020 charts. This is development research, not independent confirmation.

frozen_rules.name: OBSERVATION_SEED
frozen_rules.definition: Use only the exact frozen mother identity: at least 5% completed float transfer, at least 3 times the strictly prior-60 median, absolute coordinate close-to-close displacement no more than 1%, and the exact causal 20-session symbol cooldown. The mother event is not an entry.

frozen_rules.name: BOUNDED_EVENT_HIGH_ACCEPTANCE
frozen_rules.definition: Between global market-session offsets +5 and +10 after the mother event, find the first completed session whose coordinate close is strictly above the pre-known event coordinate high and for which at least 3 of the exact last 5 global market sessions have valid same-lineage completed coordinate closes strictly above that event high. All five observations must be present, hard-valid, tradable, corporate-action-valid, non-blocking, and available by their completed closes. Otherwise the seed expires with no trade.

frozen_rules.name: CAUSAL_MARKET_ROUTE_AT_CONFIRMATION
frozen_rules.definition: At the acceptance close, admit a frozen causal BULL state directly. If the state is TRANSITION or BEAR, admit only when both the completed 20-session cross-sectional median return is strictly greater than its completed 60-session counterpart and the completed positive-20-session-return share is strictly greater than the positive-60-session-return share. Unknown state or lineage fails closed.
frozen_rules.economic_meaning: Continuation is allowed in an established positive market; in a non-bull market the broad direction and participation must both be repairing before the stock-specific acceptance can be acted on.

frozen_rules.name: NEXT_LEGAL_OPEN_AND_STRUCTURAL_INVALIDATION
frozen_rules.definition: Enter once at the first legal non-upper-limit open in the three global market sessions strictly after the accepted close. After entry, two consecutive valid same-lineage completed coordinate closes strictly below the frozen event high trigger an exit at the first later legal non-lower-limit open. Never fill on the decision bar and never re-enter the mother event.

frozen_rules.name: FINITE_TRADE_LIFE
frozen_rules.definition: If no earlier structural exit is executable, exit at the first legal non-lower-limit open on or after 60 global market sessions from entry, provided coordinate lineage remains unchanged.

execution.price_limits: strict buy and sell open checks
execution.suspensions: wait only inside the frozen entry/exit rules; missing completion is not imputed
execution.corporate_actions: same coordinate lineage required through exit; otherwise fail closed

rejected_extra_rules: unbounded waiting for a later catalyst
